name: weighted chain sumo deadlift
description: A sumo deadlift with chains hung on the bar, so the load gets heavier as you stand up. It builds the glutes, inner thighs and back.
instructions: Hang chains on a barbell and stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out.
Grip the bar inside your knees with a flat back.
Push the floor away and drive your knees out.
Stand tall as the chains lift and the load increases.
Lock out with your glutes, then lower the bar under control.
